Method of Attack: Chaining two exploits to bypass enterprise firewalls and infect devices
Exploits CVE-2015-7755 Juniper Networks ScreenOS backdoor with hardcoded password to access device via Telnet and SSH
Exploits CVE-2016-10401 ZyXEL PK5001Z router backdoor using admin:CenturyL1nk and password zyad5001 to gain super-user access
Bypasses Juniper Netscreen firewalls and scans internal networks for ZyXEL routers to exploit
Adds compromised ZyXEL devices to a botnet structure
Attack Vector: Exploitation of backdoors in Juniper Netscreen firewalls and ZyXEL PK5001Z routers
Indicators of Compromise: Scans and exploitation attempts observed between January 18 and January 27 from South Korean IP addresses
